sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF is a 9-billion parameter dense language model built for code generation and agentic reasoning, maintained by ornith-ai. This is a quantized GGUF variant of the full-precision model, enabling deployment on consumer hardware while maintaining the reasoning capabilities of the original.

sources.title: Ornith 1.5 9B: Local Test Results Expose a Benchmark Gap
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 9B is a dense (non mixture-of-experts) model from ornith-ai, built on a Qwen3.5-based architecture and released in safetensors format on Hugging Face, with a GGUF variant aimed at mobile and single-GPU deployment.

sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: What is Ornith 1.5 9B? Ornith 1.5 9B is an open-weight dense language model developed by DeepReinforce, the smallest member of the new Ornith 1.5 family. The family is trained for agentic coding and ships in three sizes, a 397B MoE flagship, a 35B MoE, and this 9B, all under the MIT license. The 9B weights went public on Hugging Face on August 19, 2026.
